messages:
PagerDuty Bot: ALERT fired: service=postgres-connections-high severity=P1
Oncall Bot: Incident created — https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/INC123456 — paging on-call
Sam W: Acked. I'm booting up the db console and checking pgbouncer metrics. @Lina you on?
Lina C: on. seeing pgbouncer max_client reached on pg-main (pgbouncer-0). app logs show repeated:
```
ERROR: could not connect to server: Too many clients
DETAIL: Failing on accept() from 10.0.3.45:55213
```
Lina C: also seeing connection_count ~ 10200 (max_clients=10240) but active waiting > 9k. Lots of idle_txn too.
Eve R: CS reports ~12% of checkout requests 500'ing, write-heavy endpoints hit first. HDD? no, CPU normal. latency spike ~600-800ms for successful reqs
Sam W: quick triage plan: 1) try to reduce new app connections (enable connection draining on frontend), 2) kill obvious orphaned sessions, 3) open short-term pgbouncer pool bump if safe, 4) if not resolving, route read-only traffic to replica and throttle write API. executing step 1 now.
Sam W: @infra run: `kubectl patch svc frontend --type='merge' -p '{"metadata":{"annotations":{"conn-drain":"true"}}}'` — will set frontend to send 503 to new clients for a couple mins
Lina C: running `psql -h pg-main -c "SELECT pid, state, query_start, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='idle in transaction' ORDER BY query_start DESC LIMIT 50;"` — several long-running analytics jobs holding open TXNs
Lina C: dropping a few oldest idle txns: `SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='idle in transaction' AND now() - query_start > interval '10 minutes';` — removed ~120 sessions, client_count down ~500
Sam W: good. applying pgbouncer tweak: increasing pool_size by 10% on pg-main via config reload (safe for now). `kubectl exec pgbouncer-0 -- pgbouncer -R` reload
Oncall Bot: PagerDuty: INC123456 acknowledged by Sam W
Eve R: Monitoring: checkout 5xxs down from 12% -> 3% after kills, p50 latency back to ~220ms. Still some queueing but improving.
Marta S: I'll take the handoff for next 30m. plan: run a read-only redirect for non-critical endpoints, and coordinate with infra for longer term: add statement_timeout on analytics pool and increase pgbouncer reserve for short window
Sam W: agree. documenting immediate RCA: analytics jobs started by nightly ETL overran and opened many transactions without proper batching; connection pool drained by these jobs + a minor client-side retry storm increased concurrent connections. Mitigation: killed idle txns, temporarily increased pool, enabled frontend drain, applied statement_timeout to analytics role.
Marta S: filing follow-up ticket: TICKET-7892 — add connection caps per role, implement monitoring alert on idle_in_transaction ratio, and add a Playbook step to pause ETL when pool > 80%.
Sam W: closing alert window, will keep watch. thanks all :thumbsup:
PagerDuty Bot: Incident INC123456 status: resolved
Marta S: postmortem note: customer impact — 10-15% of write requests experienced 500s for ~22 minutes. CS notified. ETA for permanent fixes in TICKET-7892.
